akicca.p: [Na+kicca] (na) CL=8 1) A) Something which must not / should not do B) The matter/ case which must not - should not - not ought to - be done 2) The big / important case / matter

akiccakara.p:
[Akicca+kara] (ti) CL=8 Doing the matters which are unnecessary to do
Doing the matter like digging the well only when thirsty
a: အကိစ္စကရ(တိ)
ပြုဖွယ်မဟုတ်သည်ကို ပြုလုပ်တတ်သော၊ သည်။ ရေငတ်မှ ရေတွင်းတူးသကဲ့သို့ ပြုလုပ်သော အလုပ်မျိုး။

akiccakara：akiccakara（ti）

ပြုဖွယ်မဟုတ်သည်ကို ပြုလုပ်တတ်သော၊ သည်။ ရေငတ်မှ ရေတွင်းတူးသကဲ့သို့ ပြုလုပ်သော အလုပ်မျိုး။
C: akiccakāra：a. [a-kicca-kāra] 不做所作的，不盡義務（本分，責任）的.
S: akiccakāra：a. [a-kicca-kāra] 所作をなさざる，務めを果たさざる.
F: Akiccakāra，（a不+kicca+kāra） 【形】1.不履行自己的责任；做不应该做的。2.无效的（药） （ineffective （of medicine））。
P: Akiccakāra，（adj.） [a + kicca + kāra] 1. not doing one’s duty，doing what ought not to be done A.II，67； Dh.292； Miln.66； DA.I，296. -- 2. ineffective （of medicine） Miln.151. （Page 1）

DOP: kiccha mfn. and n. [ S. kṛcchra], 1. ( mfn. ) ( i ) causing trouble or pain; attended with pain or labour; obtained with difficulty ; Dhp 182 (~o manussapaṭilābho ~aṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ; Dhp-a III 235, 16 : ~o dullabho); Sn 676 (~ā vatāyaṃ idha vutti); Th 111 (~ā vuttī no itarītaren’ eva); Ja IV 177, 24* (~ā vutti asippassa); — ( ii ) being in a difficult or painful situation ; Pv 36:5 (nihīnatto sabbabhogehi ~o; Pv-a 220, 4 : ~o ti dukkhito, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); — 2. ( n. ) difficulty, trouble; pain ; Abh 89 (dukkhaṃ ca kasiraṃ ~aṃ); D II 30, 26 (~aṃ vatāyaṃ loko āpanno); Ja V 330, 21* (mātaraṃ aparicaritvāna ~aṃ vā so nigacchati); Vism 314, 26* ; Sv 750, 16* (anuppannesu ~esu, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee kiccesu) = Ps I 235, 26* ; — instr. ~ena, adv. , with difficulty, with great trouble ; Vin I 195, 6 (~ena kasirena tato tato dasavaggaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātetvā); S I 34, 17* (coḷaṃ piṇḍo ratī khiḍḍā yattha ~ena labbhati); Ja I 147, 15 (~ena sāmikaṃ ārādhetvā pabbajjaṃ labhi); II 84, 1* (taṃ ca ~ena no adā; 84, 5´ : taṃ ca no so caṇḍālo na attano ruciyā adāsi); Vibh 332, 1 (~ena kasirena); Mp III 140, 2 (gahanaṭṭhāne nilīnānaṃ ~en’ eva dassanaṃ viya); Dhp-a I 80, 15 (ahaṃ ime ~ena māremi); Ud-a 310, 17 (~enā ti dukkhena); — abl. ~ā, adv. , with difficulty, with great trouble ; Vin V 148, 33* (~ā laddhaṃ yaṃ bhojanaṃ); Ja II 44, 11* (~ā kataṃ paṇṇakuṭim); Cp 3:6:3 (~ā laddhaṃ piyaṃ puttaṃ); — °- laddhaka , mfn. , obtained with difficulty ; Ja VI 150, 6* (mā ~ehī puttehi yajittho imaṃ yaññaṃ, so read mc [ see L. Alsdorf, 1968, p. 289 ]; Se ~ehi; Be, Ce, Ee kicchāladdhakehi); — °- lābhi(n) , mfn. , obtaining with difficulty, only with great trouble ; A III 117, 13 (na nikāmalābhī hoti ~ī kasiralābhī, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be na akicchalābhī); Mp I 328, 23 (assa adhunā pabbajitattā ~issa); — °- vuttika , mfn. , subsisting with difficulty ; Pv-a 120, 13 ; — akiccha , n. , lack of difficulty, ease ; — instr. ~ena, adv. , with ease, without trouble ; S I 35, 2 (aḍḍhe ajāyare kule … khiḍḍā yatthākicchena labbhati); Vibh 332, 11 (~ena akasirena); Dhp-a I 260, 3 ; Mhv 15:65 (āgacchantu ~ena khippaṃ ca); Sadd 928, 8 — ~-lābhi(n), mfn. , obtaining easily ; Vin V 135, 15 (catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ … nikāmalābhī hoti ~-lābhī akasiralābhī) ≠ M I 33, 33 ; A IV 106, 10 (nagaraṃ … catunnaṃ āhārānaṃ … ~-lābhī); 342, 15 (devatā … ~-lābhiniyo); — sukiccha , mfn. and n. , attended with great misery or pain; great trouble or difficulty ; Ja IV 451, 23* (kaṭukaṃ hi sambādhaṃ ~aṃ patto, Be so; Ce, Ee, Se ~a patto [ mc ? or cpd ?]; 452, 11´ : kaṭukaṃ sambādhaṃ ~aṃ maraṇabhayaṃ patto ’mhi); — ~-rūpa, mfn. , 1. obtained with very great difficulty ; Ja V 387, 14* (~-rūpaṃ vat’ idaṃ parittaṃ); — 2. in absolute misery ; — ~-rūpaṃ, adv. , absolutely miserably; as though in terrible trouble ; Ja IV 439, 7* (~-rūpaṃ paridevayavho; 439, 19´ : suṭṭhu dukkhappattā viya hutvā); — ~-vutti, mfn. , subsisting with very great difficulty ; Pv 21:14 (~-vutti kapaṇo; Pv-a 120, 12 : suṭṭhu kicchavuttiko ativiyadukkhajīvito); — see also kasira.
NCP: neuter lack of difficulty; ease See also: kiccha

akicchalābhī.p: [Akiccha+lābhī] (ti) CL=7 The person who is usually not having grudge -being poor- being opposite - be able to abstain Nīvaraṇa Dhamma peacefully and easily and practice
